svg.title: MODE-01 — Predator in the shared arena
svg.desc: 1280 by 900 debug client. Three players occupy one undivided arena. Bruno illustrates the predator: only the body uses ten percent opacity; the held weapon stays opaque. Alice and Cora remain opaque. Standard event, finite-round progress and free-for-all ranking anchors remain intact. Role explanations appear only in the external annotation region, not as a persistent gameplay badge.

g.text: Alice: You picked up gun laser
ANNOTATIONS — not UI. Bruno is the predator: body alpha 0.1; weapon remains opaque unless another state modifies it.
Alice and Cora are opaque marines. All three remain in the same whole-level arena; there is no persistent role badge.
Names, ammunition and status use the existing reveal rules. Round-start extra ammunition and outcomes remain unchanged.
World, water, ranking colors and sprites are schematic. Production appearance follows PLAY-01 and docs/design.md.
